class.name: JRPGEventData
class.brief_description: A map event: its id, place and pages.
class.description: A map event, stored in its map's [JRPGMapData] (never a scene node, so tools and servers read it without a scene and copying nodes can never clone an id). It has an [member event_id] unique in its map, a [member display_name] and a [member note] for the author, the [member cell] where it starts and up to [constant MAX_PAGES] [JRPGEventPage]s. Its active page is the highest-numbered page whose conditions all hold ([method find_active_page]); when no page qualifies the event is absent from the map. Authority: server. Online, the zone decides an event's page.

method.name: find_active_page
method.description: Returns the index of the active page for the game state [param state] on map [param map_id]: the highest-numbered page whose conditions all hold, or [code]-1[/code] when none does.

method.name: get_page_count
method.description: Returns how many pages the event has.

members.member: The cell where the event stands when its map is entered.
A name for the author (the game never shows it).
The event's id, unique in its map and given by [method JRPGMapData.add_event] in the order events are created.
The event's pages, at most [constant MAX_PAGES]. Empty entries are left out.

constants.constant: The most pages an event can have.
